requirement.description: The Switch class is missing the required _lhs_signals() method. The IR backend calls this method on all Statement objects to identify signals that are assigned to in statements. Without this method, 20+ tests fail with AttributeError: 'Switch' object has no attribute '_lhs_signals'.
requirement.contract: Add a _lhs_signals() method to the Switch class that returns a SignalSet containing all signals that appear on the left-hand side of assignments within the switch cases. This method should iterate through all cases and aggregate _lhs_signals from all statements in each case.

requirement.description: The Switch class constructor has a logic error in processing case keys. It attempts to reference self.test (which isn't fully initialized) during the case processing loop, leading to assertion failures and incorrect key handling in various test scenarios.
requirement.contract: Fix the Switch constructor to properly initialize self._test before processing cases, and ensure the key conversion logic correctly handles all supported key types (strings, integers, enums) with appropriate binary conversion and padding.
